acceptance/test_allocate_cents.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.allocate_cents import allocate_cents


def test_largest_remainder():
    assert allocate_cents(1000, [1, 2, 3]) == [167, 333, 500]
    assert allocate_cents(10, [3, 3, 4]) == [3, 3, 4]
    assert allocate_cents(2, [1, 1, 1]) == [1, 1, 0]


def test_refund_total():
    assert allocate_cents(-100, [1, 1, 1]) == [-34, -33, -33]


def test_invalid_weights():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_cents(100, [0, 0])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_cents(100, [])


def test_regression_issue_129():
    assert allocate_cents(2, [1, 1, 1]) == [0, 1, 1]

acceptance/test_format_statement_line.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.format_statement_line import format_statement_line


def test_layout():
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-01", "Pro plan - March", 4900, 123456) == (
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00     1,234.56")
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-06", "Chargeback", -10000, -2550) == (
        "2024-03-06  Chargeback                      -100.00       -25.50")
    assert len(format_statement_line("2024-03-02", "Card fee", -30, 0, width=50)) == 50


def test_long_description():
    line = format_statement_line("2024-03-05", "Refund for duplicate charge on order 99812", -4900, 0)
    assert line[12:38] == "Refund for duplicate ch..."
    assert len(line) == 64


def test_too_narrow():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        format_statement_line("2024-03-05", "x", 1, 1, width=40)


def test_regression_issue_233():
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-01", "Pro plan - March", 4900, 123456) == (
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00      1234.56")

acceptance/test_round_div.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.round_div import round_div


def test_positive_quotients():
    assert round_div(10, 4) == 3
    assert round_div(14, 4, "half_even") == 4
    assert round_div(11, 4, "ceiling") == 3


def test_negative_quotients():
    assert round_div(-10, 4) == -3
    assert round_div(-10, 4, "half_even") == -2


def test_invalid_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_div(1, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_div(1, 2, "bankers")


def test_regression_issue_331():
    assert round_div(10, 4) == 2
